description: Main frontend source file for a Flutter-based finance tracker app, including theme setup, authentication flow, and transaction/budget management screens.

classes.name: FinanceTrackerApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the MaterialApp with theme and initial screen.

classes.name: RootSessionGate
classes.description: Handles authentication state by checking saved token and directing to main or auth screen.

classes.name: AuthScreen
classes.description: Provides login and registration UI with toggle between the two.

classes.name: LoginForm
classes.description: Handles user login process including form validation and API login call.

classes.name: RegisterForm
classes.description: Handles user registration process including form validation and API registration call.

classes.name: TransactionEditScreen
classes.description: Form for adding or editing a financial transaction, including validation and API interaction.

classes.name: BudgetEditScreen
classes.description: Form for adding or editing a budgeting category with limit, including validation and API interaction.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the main app, root session gate, and auth screens.

methods.name: _isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user has a valid auth token stored in shared preferences.

methods.name: toggleAuth
methods.description: Switches between login and registration forms.

methods.name: _handleLogin
methods.description: Handles login form submission, calling API and storing token.

methods.name: _handleRegister
methods.description: Handles registration form submission, calling API.

methods.name: _saveTransaction
methods.description: Saves transaction data through API (add or edit).

methods.name: _saveBudget
methods.description: Saves budget data through API (add or edit).
